zh/fa01-03-10.spoken: 每航八个零和一，刚好装进一个字节。
zh/fa01-03-10.reason: 航 forces háng for the row sense of 行; captions retain 每行.

zh/fa01-04-02.spoken: 先借助大脑里的一个神经元，来想一想。
zh/fa01-04-02.reason: Make 借助 and the reduplicated verb unambiguous without changing the analogy.

zh/fa01-04-05.spoken: 人脑里的神经元，大约有八百六十亿。
zh/fa01-04-05.reason: Place the critical 亿 unit at the phrase end so it is clearly voiced.

zh/fa01-07-03.spoken: 本机那个千问模型，参数大约有八十亿。
zh/fa01-07-03.reason: Keep the critical 亿 unit clearly at the phrase end; the model card count is rounded to eight billion in the film.

zh/fa01-07-12.spoken: 比如，这次本机的千问，只答对了五张。
zh/fa01-07-12.reason: A short pause clarifies 比如 and 本机; the owner’s wording and result are unchanged.
